mentions.name: MovieMovie
mentions.description: A tiny community website about film reviews with a run-club mechanic: members must write their own review before they can see other people's reviews. Currently implementing watchlists, comments, and a mural to make the site feel less lonely.
mentions.problem: The site feels lonely right now, which the author is addressing by adding social features like comments and a mural.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on the https://moviemovie.club/about, it's a tiny website about film review.

It works like a run club, where you have to make a review first to see other people's reviews.
